mx.random.seed(434);cases=[]
for kind in ['rank1','broadcast-gate','noncontiguous','prefill32','prefill33','prefill64']:
 D=128
 if kind=='rank1':x=mx.random.normal((D,)).astype(mx.bfloat16);gate=mx.random.normal((D,)).astype(mx.bfloat16)
 elif kind=='broadcast-gate':x=mx.random.normal((2,D)).astype(mx.bfloat16);gate=mx.random.normal((D,)).astype(mx.bfloat16)
 elif kind=='noncontiguous':x=mx.random.normal((3,D*2)).astype(mx.bfloat16)[:,::2];gate=mx.random.normal((3,D*2)).astype(mx.bfloat16)[:,::2]

 for gated in [False,True]:
  a=(old.GatedRMSNorm if gated else old.RMSNorm)(D,1e-6);b=(GatedRMSNorm if gated else RMSNorm)(D,1e-6)
  weight=mx.random.normal((D,)).astype(mx.bfloat16)*.1+(1 if gated else 0);a.weight=weight;b.weight=weight
  expected=a(x,gate) if gated else a(x);actual=b(x,gate) if gated else b(x);mx.eval(expected,actual)
